item.title: About me
item.description:
Hey, my name is Sarah

I’m a computer science student, currently studying in the University of Innsbruck. Although, I have no degree yet, I have a lot of selftaught knowledge, about Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence and Digital Privacy

Just as a demonstration of my skills, I’ve setup this website all by my own and host it myself on GitHub. Along with a link to a Obsidian vault and a self-coded script to update my website! You could even call it automation.

item.title: Interests
item.description:
1. Raspberry Pi’s and Arduino

I love working with tiny computers like a small RaPi Zero, and playing around with it, to get the most of it’s functionality! Especially with Arduino’s I have played around a lot, doing fun little projects in my free-time.

I’d be happy to be taught more about them, through a apprenticeship (Lehre) and develop my skills even further.

2. Photography and Filmmaking

I love photography so much, that I even created a own subpage just for this! I would say, photography is more of a hobby, but at the same time I am quite knowledgeable.

item.title: Projects
item.description:
Rebell*innen Kalender | Amazone

I attended a Graphics Design workshop, where we were asked to help with the design process of a calendar, of which 10,000 units were produced and spread across multiple youth centers in Austria, for other young people to take and get inspired.

The design process was of course multiple days long and was organized by Amazone (Vorarlberg). The result can be viewed below: Link to the Calendar
